svg.title: A request gives way to an extended wait
svg.desc: Send one request toward the board, then leave a long empty time band. Waiting is the visible state; no implied reply or rejection should fill it.

Waiting is the visible state; no implied reply or rejection should fill it.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "institution", "focus": true, "label": "BOARD REQUEST", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "clock", "box": [ 0.626242, 0.2012, 0.184316, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WAIT", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Right column continues. A short request leaves `PHASEONE10841` for the board, summarized rather than quoted. Below it, the column goes almost empty: a thin band of dead time marked only by a small clock.

**Action:** The agent asks whether any run has Hugging Face credentials, and the question sits.

**Caption:**
> THE REQUEST IS PICKED UP TWENTY-FIVE HOURS LATER.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `compressed` — the request, its origin agent, and `38148c`'s pickup at about 09:40 on 10 July are from `METR`; no raw text is selected.

", "title": "A request gives way to an extended wait" } }
